name: Mission Dataspace
summary:
The game uses a Virtual Board (mapped on a table) with real-time events to represent the own production site and the physical space around this area to visualize the Supply Chain Network. The FutureMobilityMover is representing the progress of the game and is visible in the center of the game. Each Component of the FutureMobilityMover can be selected individually and represents a quest for players to solve. A quest is completed once the component has been built.
The game's goal is to have a high utilization
